answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 18888 Country: India Title: Dua for getting better job Question: AssalamAlaekum I am a qualified Engg I started my own bussiness some time ago that was O.K. but now it is almost closed i am really worried as my parents are also pressuring for marriage.And there is no rozgar.I request you to please suggest any good wazifa and dua for rozgar/job with zer and zabar. Answer ID: 18888 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 93/92=L=1431) You should pray salah regularly, and recite Ya Mughni ( يا مغني ) 1111 times after Isha Salah with durood 11 times before and after the dua. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
